name: Joseph Martin Dolan
sources: Ancestry.com, Washington, U.S., Marriage Records, 1854-2013 (Robert Joseph Dolan and Marrion P. Hinds, Vancouver, Clark County, 9 Jun 1937)
Find a Grave, memorial 134589927 (Joseph Martin Dolan, Mount Calvary Cemetery, Portland)
notes: Father of Sheldon Joseph Dolan, named as Martine Joseph Dolan on Sheldon's 1937 marriage record. Born 2 May 1882 in Portland, Oregon; died 6 Jul 1967 in Multnomah County and was buried at Mount Calvary Cemetery (Find a Grave). He married May Smith in 1906; after her death he married Annabel Fields in 1918, the mother of Martin Kenneth (1919–1997) and Arline (1921–2014) (Find a Grave).
UNPROVEN, from Find a Grave family links: son of Thomas Dolan (1829–1899) and Ellen Dowling (1845–1930).
